report.summary: Reviewed chunk 13 of 14 of daedalus/mapping/render.py; found acceptance logic, text summary function, and CLI argument parser. No critical issues.
risks: main | low | --accept logic computes default until as today+14 days using date.fromisoformat, but if that fails, falls back to today. This may silently produce a different date than intended. | Verify if the fallback to today is intentional and document edge cases.

main | low | The state dict copies snapshot fields verbatim; if any field is missing, it defaults to empty list or dict. This could mask missing data. | Ensure snapshot always contains all expected keys or handle missing keys explicitly.

observations.what: Default until calculation uses date.fromisoformat on d_since; if that fails, falls back to today, which may differ from intended behavior.
State dict copies snapshot fields with defaults of empty list/dict; missing keys in snapshot could lead to silent data loss.
The comment about 'today matters here' references a scenario with --since 2999-01-01, but the logic does not enforce any cap; it's just a note.
